# netactuate_statistics (Data Source)

Reads Statistics visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_statistics" "example" {
  metrics = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metrics` (List of String) Metric names to query. The provider converts each name into the nested API metric object shape.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `results` (List of Object) Statistics results returned by the API. Endpoint-specific extra fields are not surfaced. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `metric` (String)
- `samples` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--results--samples))
- `service` (String)

<a id="nestedobjatt--results--samples"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.samples`

Read-Only:

- `avg` (Number)
- `count` (Number)
- `resources` (Number)
- `sum` (Number)
